decisions.quote:
Taken together, our results indicate that the conclusions of Attanasio et al.
(2015) are robust to reasonable alternative modeling choices and index construc-
tions.
decisions.reason: Under the codebook rules for outcome_robustness, when a paper reports multiple re-analyses and states an explicit overall judgment on how to interpret the variation across specifications, that judgment governs rather than picking an isolated specification with reduced precision. Although one saturated Poisson specification (Table 2, column 6) and a 12-month age restriction (Table 5, columns 7-9) lose statistical significance, the authors explicitly judge the Poisson marginal effects as supporting the baseline modeling approach and conclude overall (in both the Abstract and Conclusion) that the main qualitative findings and conclusions of Attanasio et al. (2015) remain intact and robust.
